newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei ends weaker but off lows.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei ends weaker but off lows.

text.p: Simex Nikkei futures recovered from its intraday lows on Monday in thin trade, but still closed in negative territory compared to Friday's finish.
The benchmark September contract ended at 20,180 against Friday's close at 20,215. An estimated 18,670 lots changed hands.
"The afternoon session was even sleepier than the morning," said one dealer with a Japanese comission house, adding the September contract was taking a breather after the heavy selling last week.
Dealers said Nikkei sentiment remains gloomy as last week's release of the Bank Of Japan Tankan report reinforced market views 1996 corporate earnings will be dismal.
They said any short-term spike up will provide opportunity for technical traders waiting for the Nikkei to stage a rebound to liquidate their positions.

Market views are for the benchmark September contract to sink further to key support at 20,060 in the weeks ahead, dealers said. On Monday the September contact touched a low of 20,080. -- Valerie Lee (65 8703080)
